llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must define a key builder (for example `buildProductsQueryKey(filter, page, pageSize)`) that returns `['products', filter, page, pageSize] as const`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: No `buildProductsQueryKey` function defined. Query key is inlined as `['products', filter, page]` and omits `pageSize`. No `as const` assertion.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Query key entries must remain primitive/serializable (`'products'`, filter string, page number, pageSize number) with no functions or object references.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Inline key contains only a string literal, a string state variable, and a number state variable — all primitive/serializable. No functions or object references present.
Query function is a plain async arrow function; it does not accept a `QueryFunctionContext` argument and does not destructure `activeFilter`, `activePage`, or `activePageSize` from `queryKey`.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must use TanStack Query v5 object-form APIs (`useQuery({ ... })`, client object filters), not legacy positional signatures.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: `useQuery` is called with the legacy v4 two-argument positional form `useQuery(queryKey, queryFn)` instead of the v5 object form `useQuery({ queryKey, queryFn, ... })`.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must set `placeholderData` as `(previous) => previous` to keep previous page/category data visible during refetch.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: `placeholderData` option is absent entirely from the `useQuery` call.
